allow: PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "node|next" } | Select-Object Id, Name, CPU, StartTime)
PowerShell(Get-Process -Id 24792, 33764, 35768, 38772 | ForEach-Object { $p = $_; try { $p | Select-Object Id, @{N='Path';E={$_.MainModule.FileName}} } catch { "$\($p.Id\): access denied" } })

PowerShell(Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "node" } | Select-Object Id, @{N='CommandLine';E={ \(Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine }} | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match "next" })
